response.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS fundflux, AVG((s.boxy - s.boxx) / NULLIF(s.boxx, 0)) AS avg_diff, SUM(s.aream2) / NULLIF(SUM(s.volm3), 0) AS av_ratio FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry GROUP BY p.fundflux), g AS (SELECT AVG(av_ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM per) SELECT per.fundflux, per.avg_diff AS avg_y_vs_x_difference, per.av_ratio AS area_to_volume_ratio, per.av_ratio - g.avg_ratio AS above_average_by FROM per CROSS JOIN g WHERE per.av_ratio > g.avg_ratio
